plan.notes: Source: official UWSP Sample Graduation Plan, Department of Sociology and Social Work (file SOC-Online-Grad-Plan.pdf, titled 'BS/BA Sociology (in person)'). Covers both the BS and BA tracks; modeled as BS. The plan states it 'is not meant to serve as an official document' and refers students to their adviser and the University Catalog (https://catalog.uwsp.edu/). No catalog year printed; filed under 2026-2027 as the current catalog at collection time. SOURCE INCONSISTENCY: the courses listed for Semester 8 sum to 15 credits (SOC 492 + SOC 493 + 3 electives) but the plan prints 'Total credits 14' for that semester and 'Total credits 121' overall; every listed course is modeled as printed, giving a modeled total of 122. 'Elective or second major, minor, or certificate course' slots modeled as free electives. Prerequisites not listed on the plan; see the catalog. Items marked * are dependent on placement.
